verifications.claim: U.S. stock markets (NYSE and Nasdaq) are closed on Good Friday, April 3, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The Nasdaq and New York Stock Exchange will be closed on Friday" (R1); "The Nasdaq and the New York Stock Exchange will be closed on Good Friday" (R2); "The stock markets on New York Stock Exchange and the Nasdaq are closed for trading on Good Friday, April 3, 2026" (R4); "the New York Stock Exchange and the Nasdaq - will be closed on Friday, April 3" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state NYSE and Nasdaq closure on the exact date.

verifications.claim: U.S. stock markets will reopen on Monday, April 6, 2026, at 9:30 a.m. ET.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm reopening on April 6, but no source specifies the 9:30 a.m. ET time, though it is standard.

verifications.claim: The U.S. bond market will have an early closure at noon ET on Friday, April 3, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The U.S. bond market will close at noon ET Friday" (R1); "Good Friday Early Close (12:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Friday, April 3, 2026" (R3); "early close at noon EST for the holiday" (R4); "U.S. bond markets are expected to close early - at noon" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm early closure at noon ET on the exact date.

verifications.claim: Most major banks will be open for regular business on Good Friday, April 3, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "most banks will be open for regular business hours" (R2); "Most banks will be open on Good Friday, April 3, 2026" (R4); "Banks... will generally be open as well" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state most banks open for regular business on the date.

verifications.claim: USPS will operate as normal on Good Friday, April 3, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The United States Postal Service will be open, and mail will be delivered on Good Friday, April 3, 2026" (R4); "the U.S. Postal Service is open for business as usual" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly confirm USPS open and operating normally on the date.

verifications.claim: London and Paris exchanges are closed on Good Friday, April 3, 2026.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "Good Friday Friday, April 3, 2026" under U.K. Holiday Recommendations (implies closure for London/U.K.)
verifications.reasoning: U.K. (London) supported as closed; Paris not mentioned in any source.

verifications.claim: Tokyo and Shanghai markets remain open on Good Friday, April 3, 2026.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "Good Friday Friday, April 3, 2026" under Japan Holiday Recommendations (implies closure for Tokyo/Japan)
verifications.reasoning: R3 lists Good Friday as a holiday recommendation for Japan (Tokyo), contradicting openness; Shanghai not mentioned.

verifications.claim: The next scheduled stock market holiday is Memorial Day on Monday, May 25, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The next scheduled stock market closure is on Monday, May 25, in observance of Memorial Day" (R1); "Memorial Day Monday, May 25, 2026" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly identify Memorial Day May 25, 2026, as the next closure after Good Friday.
